question: True or false: a shop that prices goods at cost plus 50% keeps half of each sale as margin?
answer: False. Buy at €100 and sell at €150, and the €50 kept is a third of the price, not half. Markup is measured on the cost and margin on the sale, so the same €50 is 50% one way and 33% the other.
move: Name the base of every percentage before you compare two of them.
trap: Reading fifty per cent on the cost as fifty per cent of the price.
reference: Paulos, Innumeracy: Mathematical Illiteracy and Its Consequences, Hill and Wang, 1988
